declaration_scope: Prospective scientific contract declared before integral implementation and new numerical candidates
purpose: Connect the remaining 72 primary-crosschecked BaBar RF0 z1/z2 amplitudes to separate finite-momentum integrals at literal rounded KPSY parameters. This diagnostic is a prerequisite for historical reconstruction, not an accepted likelihood, recovered author fit or production extraction.

selection.kinematics: Retain literal reported z1/z2 means and legacy Q2=112.36 GeV2, all primary z-bin edges, source order and locators. Q2 is conditional and not verified by these primary tables. Do not replace it by 10.58^2. The primary-crosschecked reported P mean is metadata, not an evaluation point or an integration limit.
selection.units: Preserve normalized fraction-valued central values and separate statistical/reported-systematic errors. Historical intake applies the original percentage conversion exactly once. No Belle correction or second percentage conversion.
selection.cuts: Retain all 72 selected rows and the historical source selection. The source event-level qT<3.5 cut informs the declared model window; neither a cut on mean(P)/mean(z1) nor an additional row exclusion is inferred.
selection.source_integrity: Rebuild and verify all current historical intake outputs and primary decisions. Bind the complete raw/primary input set, candidate/report files, scientific contracts, source fingerprint, literal rows and order. Cached requests must be reconstructed from sources; rehashing edited fields does not validate them.

primary_definition.checked_fields: Each of 72 rows has exact primary checks of both z means, four z-bin endpoints, reported P mean, angular mean, central value, statistical error and reported systematic error.

upper_cut.definition: Event-level Q_t cut in the primary selection; the same selection is applied to all charge pairs.

primary_definition.angular: Use the primary hadron2 mean[sin^2(theta2)/(1+cos^2(theta2))] scalar as SIAMeanOfRatio, once, preserving its publication averaging measure and joint_acceptance_unresolved status.
primary_definition.scope: Equation, source-row and upper-cut provenance only. These sources do not recover the original fitter, a full joint acceptance, exact finite-amplitude double-ratio extraction or an experimental lower acceptance boundary.

prediction.parameters: The unchanged 13-coordinate initial-contract.json published_parameters, retained as literal rounded Table1 inputs, not unrounded author optimizer states or a new optimum.
prediction.lower_limit_source: Caller-declared radial origin for this conditional reconstruction; not an independently certified experimental lower acceptance.
prediction.map: At each fixed reported mean z1 use Pmin=z1*0 and Pmax=z1*3.5. Retain P*dP=z1^2*qT*dqT in absolute polarized and unpolarized integrals. This is not a bin/event integral in varying z1 and does not equate means of ratios with ratios of means.
prediction.acceptance: Uniform momentum acceptance and factorization of the reported angular scalar from fixed-z kinematic integrals are explicit reconstruction assumptions. No full z-bin, angle/kinematic or detector acceptance is certified.
prediction.categories: Retain all pp,pm,mp,mm charge-pair integrals separately. U=pm+mp, L=pp+mm and C=U+L, separately for signed Collins and positive UU integrals.
prediction.formula: A_UL=Ftheta*(I_CU/I_DU-I_CL/I_DL); A_UC=Ftheta*(I_CU/I_DU-(I_CU+I_CL)/(I_DU+I_DL)), where each I is a separate P*dP integral. Do not average pointwise normalized amplitudes or replace the integral by the reported P mean.
prediction.physics: Reuse the inherited hadron2 J0/J2, z/mass, matching, CSS and homogeneous Collins evolution conventions without modification. DSS14 is the active pinned parton input; other build inputs may be verified but are not used by SIA.
prediction.source_range: Strict Q0 initial samples with explicit inherited reference continuation at radial scales; no production range admission.
prediction.preparation_reference_scope: The context's reference momentum is a preparation setting, not a measurement or a point approximation. The observable's finite momentum weights determine every integrated prediction.
prediction.numerical_loop: Julia initial-parameter arithmetic, retained fixed-row products, CSS damping and integrated Fourier weights only. No native/provider, Python or language-model calls inside parameter evaluation.

source_inventory.scope: Source inventory only; not a timing, memory or production throughput certificate.

preparation_reuse.optional_reuse: Fixed query blocks may be reused only under identical native/source/binary/initial-sample/coupling identities, exact query value, complete radial scale list, matching/native settings and range policy. Preserve each query's existing grid and the complete retained evolution/convolution/interpolation/coupling path. Combining queries alone does not remove per-unique-query native construction.
preparation_reuse.comparators: Before admitting a new preparation cache, compare every reused query's rows and all 36 geometry outputs against the unchanged separate-query construction at the same declared settings. Retain source-bound operators, comparison operands and mutation controls. Reuse remains outside parameter evaluation; no cross-parameter response cache is authorized.
preparation_reuse.isolation: Serialize native construction within a worker; retained Fortran module state is not thread-safe by assumption. Separate worker processes own their complete contexts. Never modify external pins.

numerical_policy.momentum_acceptance: For each distinct native/radial preparation and each finite radial bound, retain momentum refinements. Accept only at order>=64 when adjacent orders agree within 1e-7 for all four pair UU/Collins integrals, U/L/C sums and both UL/UC amplitudes. Exhaustion is FAIL. Native and tail comparisons use converged momentum values; retain the actual order per preparation.
numerical_policy.native_acceptance: Require at least three joint native/matching/radial levels at bound24. All selected pair yields, category sums and amplitudes must satisfy the unchanged adjacent-level 1e-4 target. Keep each coarse miss and every resource stop. Do not widen a threshold or report a missing check as passing.
numerical_policy.tail_acceptance: At the selected fine native setting retain bounds12/24/32 and require the converged-momentum bound24-to32 difference <=1e-4 for every absolute pair/category integral and amplitude. This is finite extension evidence, not a proof of the infinite tail.
numerical_policy.independent_reference: At final fixed native rows compare every charge-pair integral, category sum and amplitude with existing independent scalar charge/CSS/Bessel assembly using adaptive qT integration at 1e-4. Preserve P*dP=z1^2*qT*dqT in absolute yields. Shared rows/initial functions are not independent evolution.
numerical_policy.source_projection: Retain the existing 256-bit normalized-yield first-derivative Fourier fixture, both numerator signs, UL/UC, positive-count bound and all seven angular/harmonic/category/sign counterfactuals for every source angular scalar. Label this fixture synthetic, not experimental validation.
numerical_policy.fixed_value_controls: Verify exact category and ratio algebra, positive UU integrals, point IDs/order, literal source/error fields, shared UL/UC fixed preparation, global simultaneous Collins-sign invariance and independence of the first six transversity coordinates. Keep object-reuse and temporal checks as producer attestations.

representative_derivative_policy.scope: Both UL/UC outputs at these three prospectively selected low/middle/high diagonal geometries, not a global production derivative or all72-geometry certificate.
representative_derivative_policy.stencil: Use the inward fourth-order one-sided derivative (-25*f(0)+48*f(h)-36*f(2h)+16*f(3h)-3*f(4h))/(12*h), for positive coordinate directions and the fixed listed direction. Never cross literal Table1 boundaries to apply an interior central stencil.
representative_derivative_policy.reference: Compare all13 Julia AD gradient columns and HVPs against independent scalar/adaptive-qT reference derivatives and the two retained 256-bit one-sided stencil levels. Each level and their adjacent difference must meet 1e-7. First six SIA gradient columns remain exactly zero. Retain all operands and misses.
representative_derivative_policy.stencil_controls: Before physical use, verify the one-sided formula on independently differentiated polynomials through degree5 and exp(7*x), including the signed truncation and halving behavior. Label these controls synthetic and keep them separate from the physical-source checks.

observations_and_products.errors: Keep statistical and reported systematic components separate, with original column labels including syt_u. Preserve UL/UC and projection overlap, missing covariance and all source limitations. No combined errors, likelihood, chi2, pulls, normalization nuisance or uncertainty intervals.
observations_and_products.products: Source-bound request, whole Julia prediction report with all refinement/integral/reference operands and failed levels, separate Julia audit, ordered CSV and a discrete UL/UC fixed-model comparison against the measured z-bin amplitudes. Preserve reported P solely as source metadata. Raw sources, contexts, logs and run outputs stay out of Git.
observations_and_products.audit: Verify exact current source/request/contract/build bindings and independently recompute stored scalar arithmetic. Explicitly distinguish retained producer object/temporal attestations and any operation not reexecuted. A checksum or completion marker alone never accepts a diagnostic or a fit.
observations_and_products.failure_retention: Use fresh request and numerical output paths. Declare completion-only scheduler outputs, preserving FAIL reports, audits, invocations, progress and logs. Test an explicitly synthetic complete-job failure and forged-marker rejection without claiming numerical validation.
observations_and_products.cache_controls: Reject source/value/unit/covariance edits, rehashed geometry or angular definition, window bounds/provenance or Jacobian changes, integrated-to-point substitution, source P treated as a bound, Q2 relabeled primary-verified, stale operators/builds/source fingerprints, edited predictions/figures/derivative operands and production-scope substitution. Restore original bytes and timestamps and verify again.

required_checks: Complete real-source integral workflow with numerical/audit/source/cache/failure-retention controls
validation_policy.status_policy: Only the complete declared diagnostic may pass. Absent, failed, stale, exhausted or unimplemented checks remain unaccepted. A source-only review, toy closure, partial derivative sample or point-prediction receipt cannot authorize the integral diagnostic, production job or fitting.

limitations: The 72-point integral diagnostic alone does not reproduce the full historical fit or provide experimental admission
Uniform momentum acceptance, caller-declared zero lower bound, fixed z means and angular factorization do not recover event/bin acceptance
Legacy Q2=112.36 is conditional and not checked by the selected primary tables
UL/UC and other-view overlap/covariance, corrected Belle32 primary/version and species/target prescriptions remain separate work
Homogeneous Collins evolution and reference input continuation remain reconstructed; author fitter/modified HOPPET/unrounded states remain unlocated
The original point-refinement misses, paper-center/coupling FAILs and all production prerequisites remain unchanged
No real-data fit, physical extraction, full-x lattice constraint, global optimum, production throughput or interval coverage
B0 historical262, B1 updated SIDIS/SIA, B2/B3 STAR200/510, B4 paired full-x lattice, V1 robustness, uncertainty and publication products remain required
